01 / VISIBLE

Understand the decision.

Reveal excluded files and inspect the source, pattern, and rule behind each result.

02 / DELIBERATE

Preview comes first.

Selection and transfer are separate steps. An excluded file is never a request to delete a remote copy.

03 / YOURS

Keep control locally.

No application account, telemetry, or required rclone installation. The desktop and CLI share one Go core.

DESKTOP APP · 0.1.0-ALPHA.1

Get the desktop app.

Open a folder in the graphical interface. Explore files, inspect exclusions, and preview changes against a simulated destination.

⌘

Download for macOS

macOS 13 or later · Graphical desktop app

Apple Silicon ARM64 · .dmg↓ Intel Mac x64 · .dmg↓

Install: Open the downloaded disk image, drag LedgeSync.app to Applications, then open LedgeSync. Choose Apple Silicon for a Mac with an Apple M-series chip; choose Intel for an Intel Mac.

OFFLINE DEVELOPER ALPHA

Local browsing and simulated previews only. Google Drive transfers are in development. These builds have no trusted publisher signature; macOS builds are not notarized, so your operating system may prevent launch. Keep its security protections enabled. Build from reviewed source for development.

Need a terminal or server version? Separate CLI downloads and checksums are available in the release. See the passing build results and platform matrix for validation and installation limits.

BUILT IN THE OPEN

A careful start.
A clear direction.

LedgeSync is at the beginning of its implementation. Follow the code, run the offline alpha, and help shape what comes next.

Contribute ↗
